New iPhone Models Launch in India Amidst High Consumer Demand

Apple's latest iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max models went on sale across India on their official launch day. Eager customers formed long queues outside Apple stores, including the BKC store in Mumbai, to be among the first to purchase the new devices. Several retail partners, such as BigBasket, Blinkit, and Zepto, also reported significant sales, with some delivering hundreds of units within an hour of the launch. Offers including bank discounts and EMI options were available for the new models. Some reports also highlighted viral memes related to the iPhone launch.
